title: Phoenix NPU PQC: Post-Quantum Cryptography Research for AMD Phoenix NPU1
description: A public research repository for FIPS 202 SHA-3/SHAKE, FIPS 203 ML-KEM, and FIPS 204 ML-DSA work on AMD Ryzen AI Phoenix NPU1. The v0.1.0-rc.4 snapshot preserves audited provenance and narrow physical milestones while explicitly retaining the unresolved DR2d 0/25 result and making no complete 100% NPU-residency claim.
